title: A test: steel plate refined in a public facility at Node Beta (refine_steel, 5 iron ore for 2 plate and a fee) from the pilot's own stored iron ore
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-17 03:58 UTC (requests.log ENT-190, part 1). refine_steel takes 5 iron ore for 2 steel plate in a facility (catalog: iron_refinery, industrial_forge, steel_production_complex, state_of_the_art_steel_foundry; 0.54 ticks a run); asked without the workshop preset the game rents a public facility (a quote of 2026-11-15 read 19 cr: 10 labor, 9 fee). By hand basic_iron_smelting takes 10 iron for 1 plate at 0 cr. venue facility and max_fee are route_run.py's since commit 30a7961. max_fee 36 cr a run: the catalog's base value of the 2 plates a run makes (18 cr each), above which a plate costs more than it is worth (the Fleet Admiral's line). 100 runs: 500 iron ore, 200 plates. One ship until its first RESULT line is read; then the recipe of the three craft-steel routes is set by what a plate costs in ore and in credits each way. 2026-11-17 04:20 UTC (Apollo): first run 04:08 UTC, 200 plates from 500 iron ore for 2,900 cr (29 cr a run) in 1.3 minutes; out of every plan while the Fleet Admiral weighs the fee (requests.log ENT-200).
